title: When the Letters Turns
author: Ines Oyelaran
blurb: Felix Ravensworth, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
